body:
<!-- plain-summary -->
For the new FoundationDB storage code to be trustworthy, our automated test system needs to run it against a real FoundationDB server on every relevant change — the same way we already test the TiKV version. This issue sets up that test infrastructure, plus the local developer tooling and dependency-security checks.

## What

Dev and CI harness for the `fdb` feature, mirroring what M4 built for TiKV:

1. **Local dev cluster** — a docker-compose service running `foundationdb` (official image, current 7.3/7.4 stable line), single-process memory-or-ssd config, init step that runs `fdbcli --exec "configure new single memory"` on first boot, and the generated `fdb.cluster` file exposed to the host. One `make`/script entry point.
2. **Doctor rows** — extend the environment doctor with: `libfdb_c` present/loadable, cluster file readable, `fdbcli --exec status minimal` healthy (parallel to the existing `docker info` / TiKV rows pattern).
3. **CI conformance workflow** — a workflow that boots the FDB container and runs the `metadata-fdb` conformance suite (`run_all`, all 7 contracts) plus the driver-level race tests, on PRs touching the driver and nightly. This is the FDB counterpart of the nightly TiKV conformance job proposed in #420 — build them on the same pattern so neither backend rots silently.
4. **Dependency policy** — bring the `fdb` feature into the `cargo deny`/audit graph. Note the pleasant contrast with #420's problem: the `foundationdb` crate links `libfdb_c` via FFI and does NOT drag a pinned tonic/rustls tree, so the advisory surface is much smaller; what audit can't see (the C library itself) is covered by tracking upstream FDB release notes — record that split in the audit policy doc.

## Acceptance criteria

- `docker compose up fdb && cargo test -p metadata-fdb --features fdb` green locally from a clean checkout.
- CI job green and required for changes under `crates/metadata-fdb/`.
- Doctor reports the three FDB rows; failure text says how to fix (install client pkg / start compose service).
- `cargo deny check` passes with the `fdb` feature enabled.

## Sequencing

Depends on #438 (the driver must exist to be tested; the compose file and doctor rows can land alongside it). Independent of the server-selection issue. Targets `main` after `feat/m4-production-metadata-backend` merges.

milestone.description: Production distributed MetadataStore backend on FoundationDB — the chosen production backend per ADR-0042. metadata-fdb behind the fdb feature (implementation-first per ADR-0002; contract docs consolidated afterwards in #437), libfdb_c packaging + wyrd:fdb image, dev/CI harness, deploy profiles, go/no-go fault+contention battery, and the TiKV development stand-down once FDB is the default. (Renamed from metadata-client.)

title: FDB dev/CI harness: docker cluster, doctor rows, conformance workflow, deny/audit graph
